source.note: Desk is the queue of record. This file is a SELECTION over the board (snapshot 2026-09-03T01:18Z), not a second backlog. Re-select from the live board before each work run; drop anything that has since appeared on claims.bounded.tools.

cannot: pull private GHCR images or run podman

items.task: Add a top-of-file doc comment to packages/prx/src/intake/intake-source.ts.
items.verify: Comment accurately describes every export in the file (checked against the code); repo lint/typecheck passes.

items.task: Promote high-value homepage copy into content/strings.json (close the coverage gap).
items.verify: Every homepage string the issue names resolves from strings.json; site build passes; rendered homepage text is byte-identical before/after.

items.task: Resolve the confusion between the `site` repo cloned as bounded.tools/ and the separate bounded-systems/bounded.tools repo — document the relationship, propose (do not execute) any rename.
items.verify: README in both repos states which is which and why, citing the other by URL.

items.task: Embedded webfont token vs the system font stack — implement the option the issue converges on.
items.verify: Repo build/test passes; the token is the single source for font-family.

items.task: docs: how to bootstrap a first release + the tag-creation-actor requirement.
items.verify: A fresh agent following only the doc can list the exact steps and the actor requirement without reading code.

items.task: Fix the unqualified `claude-box:latest` pod default (fully qualify the image ref). The private-GHCR half of the issue is an owner action — note it, do not attempt.
items.verify: grep finds no unqualified image ref in pod defaults; repo tests pass.

items.task: Headless planner ignores the work unit's issue body and confabulates from its system prompt. Find where the issue body is dropped; fix so the body reaches the planner prompt.
items.verify: A unit test asserts the issue body text appears in the planner's rendered prompt; suite passes.

items.task: Pilot loops on the implement stage: tester leg is served the executor profile + plan instead of a test session. Trace the profile selection and fix.
items.verify: A test asserts the tester leg receives the tester profile; suite passes.

items.task: Rework dev-contracts + dismiss false-positive Trunk test-fixture SSH-key leak findings.
items.verify: Trunk check runs clean on fixtures; the dismissal is scoped to fixture paths only.

items.task: Delta sync: replace the 1,314-point full-board pull with an incremental pull.
items.verify: Test proves a second sync after a single-item change fetches only that delta; suite passes.
Test asserts consumedPoints accumulates per window and resets at the boundary; suite passes.

items.task: Wire axe / real a11y verification into the gate.
items.verify: Gate fails on a deliberately injected a11y violation and passes on main.

items.task: Audit: mint-released repo ⇒ release identity can create v* tags (implements trellis#34). Write the audit check; report findings across the org's public repos.
items.verify: Audit runs and produces a per-repo pass/fail table with evidence paths.

items.task: Flip keeper-wire contract-check to blocking — ONLY if upstream drift is already fixed. Scout first; if drift remains, report what is still drifting and stop.
items.verify: Contract-check passes in blocking mode on main, or a drift report names the exact mismatches.

items.task: Assess what is needed to run guest-room doors (claude-box / netd) inside a Cowork cloud sandbox with no podman. Gap list; implement gaps under ~200 lines behind a 'nopodman' profile.
items.verify: Repo tests pass; gap list names each unimplemented gap with reason.
